name: vincentlauriat-toolkit
description: A personal collection of Claude Code plugins for strategic audit, product framing, IT governance, and AI research — built as a hobby by Vincent Lauriat.

plugins.name: audit-report
plugins.description: Generate exhaustive audit dossiers on any company, product, technology, or market — like a strategy consulting firm. Produces structured Markdown files covering history, market, technical, pricing, competition, financials, and future outlook.

plugins.name: app-specs
plugins.description: Interview the user about an app idea, then write six consistent framing documents: PRD, TRD, app flow, UI/UX design brief, backend schema and implementation plan.
